concept.title: Recognizing Threats
concept.shortdesc: Learn how to recognize common scams and online threats.

conbody.p: Recognizing threats is important because everyone is a potential target for a scam. Spotting a threat early is the best way to stop this from happening to you. The topics in this section show you what to watch for.

ul.li: Phishing: how to avoid scams that try to trick you into clicking harmful links or giving away personal information.
AI threats: how to identify scams that use AI, like realistic fake voice calls from loved ones.
Online safety: how to protect yourself online and on social media.
